maria: External pentest report dropped. 12 findings (3 high). Need owners for RBAC, KMS, logs, and retest slot.
aj: Link? Need to know which highs need assessor access.
maria: https://redwood-sec.s3/assessments/2026-03-22/ext-pt-report.pdf. High1 = debug token leak (logs + code patch). High2 = admin-role mapping (RBAC change). High3 = KMS policy wildcard principal.
lina: I can pull log exports and produce query samples. Will redact PII.
tom: I'll build an evidence bundle (CloudTrail, API GW, app logs) and upload with HMAC.
infra-platform: We own rw-main-v1 key; will draft least-priv policy diff and a rollback plan.
katie: DevEx will create remediation runbook + retest verification checklist for QA.
aj: For RBAC, propose timeboxed assume-role with MFA and canary rollout. Need acceptance criteria.
katie: Acceptance: auth success >=99.5%, no uptick in 5xx, tests passing.
pen-test-bot: evidence-bucket: upload complete (evidence-2026-03-22.tgz), presigned URL expires 2026-03-29.
maria: Tentative retest: Mon 2026-03-29 afternoon. Internal dry-run Mon 09:30. Owners: lina (logs, Fri EOD), aj (RBAC plan, Mon AM), infra-platform/tom (KMS diff, Fri EOD), katie (runbook, Thu COB). Flag blockers here.
aj: I'll aim for Mon AM dry-run, will escalate if auth spikes.
lina: Starting log export now.
katie: Scheduling QA verification.
maria: Keep thread updates as the audit trail. :thumbsup:
